compiled_state.title: GREEN: Remove score-based language from REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md, review-fix-dispatch.md, sprint SKILL.md
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md does not reference REVIEW_RESULT, MIN_SCORE, or numeric score thresholds for pass/fail determination
- DD3: review-fix-dispatch.md instructs resolution sub-agents to extract the findings array only, with no reference to a scores object
- DD4: sprint SKILL.md uses severity-based language instead of 'all scores >= 4' and 'REVIEW_RESULT: passed'

## Files to modify

### 1. plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md
Find all 6 occurrences of REVIEW_RESULT, MIN_SCORE, and 'all scores >= 4'. For each:

a) Step 7 pass criterion (line ~1036):
   Change: 'No Critical or Important issues (all scores >= 4) → proceed to Step 8'
   To: 'No Critical, Important, or Fragile findings → proceed to Step 8'

b) Step 7 fail criterion:
   Change: 'Critical or Important issues found (any score < 4, OR any critical/important finding regardless of score)'
   To: 'Critical, Important, or Fragile findings found'

c) CONTEXT ANCHOR block (line ~1042):
   'REVIEW_RESULT: passed is received from the review sub-agent'
   Update to: 'FINDING_COUNT: 0 (or only minor findings) is returned from the review sub-agent'
   The CONTEXT ANCHOR is a guard against stopping after review — keep the guard, update the signal name.

d) Any other MIN_SCORE or REVIEW_RESULT references: replace with severity-based equivalents.
   - 're-review passes (MIN_SCORE >= 4 and no critical findings)' → 're-review passes (no critical/important/fragile findings)'

### 2. plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/review-fix-dispatch.md
Line 74:
   Change: 'Parse the JSON: extract findings array and scores object.'
   To: 'Parse the JSON: extract the findings array.'
   (scores object is no longer part of the schema)

### 3. plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md
Line ~1736 (search for 'all scores >= 4'):
   Change: '**No Critical or Important issues** (all scores >= 4) → proceed to Step 8'
   To: '**No Critical, Important, or Fragile findings** → proceed to Step 8'

Line ~1742 (search for 'REVIEW_RESULT: passed'):
   Change: '> **CONTEXT ANCHOR**: When REVIEW_RESULT: passed is received...'
   To: '> **CONTEXT ANCHOR**: When the review sub-agent returns FINDING_COUNT: 0 or only minor/fragile findings...'
   (Update the signal name but KEEP the CONTEXT ANCHOR guard — it prevents the sprint orchestrator from stopping after review)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md does not contain 'MIN_SCORE' (except in historical context comments)
  Verify: ! grep -q 'MIN_SCORE' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md
- [ ] REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md does not contain 'all scores >= 4'
  Verify: ! grep -q 'all scores >= 4' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md
- [ ] review-fix-dispatch.md does not reference scores object extraction
  Verify: ! grep -q 'scores object' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/review-fix-dispatch.md
- [ ] sprint SKILL.md does not contain 'all scores >= 4'
  Verify: ! grep -q 'all scores >= 4' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md
- [ ] test-review-workflow-severity-schema.sh passes (new structural contract tests from Task A)
  Verify: find $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests -name '*severity-schema*' -exec bash {} \; 2>&1 | grep -q 'PASSED'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
